strategy_roster.name: Table to Filter Trades Per Day
strategy_roster.notes: The documented SMA(50)/SMA(200) bullish and bearish crosses are translated directly. The table-based daily trade limiter and fixed currency targets have no supplied numeric percentage or DSL state, so they are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: VLT Trader Filter
strategy_roster.entry_long: high - low <= sma(high - low,20) and close > donchian_high_prev(high,20)
strategy_roster.notes: A range no larger than its 20-bar average followed by a prior-high break approximates the smallest-candle volatility filter and stop-order breakout. CandleCount, pip offsets, and pending-order mechanics are not represented.

strategy_roster.name: Exp CandlesticksBW Tm
strategy_roster.notes: MACD(5,34) with a five-period EMA is used as a compact Awesome/Accelerator momentum proxy for the documented six-state candle colors. Color buffers, signal-bar offsets, session filtering, and 1000/2000-point protection are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Varanormal Mac N Cheez
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(9)/SMA(21) crossover and inverse exit retain the documented trend rules. The daily currency target, fixed loss amount, trailing offset, and 5-minute scheduling cannot be represented by the percentage fields or indicator DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Band Squeeze
strategy_roster.entry_long: bb_upper(close,20,2) - bb_lower(close,20,2) < sma(bb_upper(close,20,2) - bb_lower(close,20,2),20) and close > bb_upper(close,20,2)
strategy_roster.notes: Bollinger(20,2) width below its 20-bar average plus an upper-band break preserves the documented squeeze-release long setup. The exact lower-band release, session fields, and typical 2x ATR stop are not fixed percentage exits.

strategy_roster.name: Squeeze Pro Overlays
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20) plus/minus 2 ATR(20) approximates the Keltner envelope, while Bollinger(20,2) outside the envelope represents squeeze release. Linear-regression slope is approximated by ROC(5); no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: US Index First 30m Candle
strategy_roster.notes: A break above the prior candle high approximates the locked first-30-minute range; the opposite low break supplies the long exit. Session locking, one-trade-per-day state, range-derived stops, and RiskReward=1 cannot be encoded.

strategy_roster.name: Derivative Zero Cross
strategy_roster.notes: ROC(14) percent momentum is a direct proxy for the source derivative and its zero-line sign change. The derivative smoothing, side permissions, and point-based stop/target values are unavailable; 14 is a documented fallback.

strategy_roster.name: Symbol Sync
strategy_roster.notes: This is a symbol-propagation utility rather than a market strategy, so the impossible guard prevents fabricated trades. Linked-strategy state, security identifiers, and chart-limit controls are outside the OHLCV DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Graph Style 4th Dimension RSI
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) crossing the documented 70 extreme with positive price change represents a bullish confirmation; returns toward 50/30 are exits. The explicit 1% stop is retained, while the exact fourth-dimension price-change rule and short branch are approximated.
